description: This file contains support routines for creating and managing Git packfiles, including functions for printing pack headers, objects, and trailers, as well as utilities for handling object deltas and pack cleaning.

methods.name: uint32_octal
methods.description: Prints the big-endian 4-byte octal representation of a number.

methods.name: uint32_binary
methods.description: Prints the big-endian 4-byte binary representation of a number.

methods.name: pack_header
methods.description: Prints the header of a pack with specified object count.

methods.name: pack_obj
methods.description: Outputs the pack data for a specific object, possibly as a delta, handling various predefined objects.

methods.name: pack_trailer
methods.description: Computes and appends the pack trailer to a file.

methods.name: clear_packs
methods.description: Removes existing pack files from the Git object directory.
